title: Hermetic GeGLU Airlocks and Domain-Adaptive Context Distillation: Exact Zero-Crosstalk Multi-Domain Function Embedding in Quantized GGUF Foundation Models
read_level: full (13-page PDF); reproducibility kit zip listed but scripts and JSON logs not read
metadata_mismatch: Concept DOI 24128861 resolves to version record 24128862. Zenodo creator 'moneykoikoi' vs paper 'Moneykoikoi'. PDF internal metadata title is 'Orthogonal Soundproof Weight Programming - Moneykoikoi (2026)', the author's earlier paper. Title in task list was truncated; full title matches the paper.
why_wsp: Out of scope: appended GeGLU neurons whose gates come from a convex margin program and whose up/down weights are trained with AdamW context distillation (2 epochs, STE); a gradient optimizer is the primary author of the values and no LLM editor is involved.
exclusion_reason: Up/down weights of the appended neurons are fitted by AdamW distillation (gradient optimizer is primary author); no LLM editor; 'weight-space programming' used only as a label.
domain: multi-domain capability embedding in a quantized LLM (RISC-V ALU simulation, ARC-style grids, Japanese prose editing)
editor: none (convex gate synthesis + AdamW context distillation from the base model's own skill-prompted outputs)
target: Gemma-4-E4B-it derived 'Clean-Apex v7' Q4_K_M GGUF (4.580 GiB), +512 neurons in layers 29, 35, 41
interface: other (GGUF binary splicing; trained appended neurons)
self_editing: no (teacher trajectories come from the base model, but weights are set by gradient distillation)
fraction_or_count_of_weights_changed: "appending +512 neurons per target layer" in 3 layers; base weights copied "byte-for-byte"

headline_results.quote: exact 0.000000 maximum and mean logprob drift across all 10 unrelated general control prompts
enabling all 14 orthogonal cartridges simultaneously degraded overall 42-task accuracy from 69.05% (29/42) to 64.29% (27/42)

cost.quote: optimization is restricted to 2 epochs (378 total steps across 189 verified trajectories, AdamW lr = 3.6 × 10−4

baselines_and_controls: Unexpanded base GGUF; legacy 14 linear orthogonal cartridges; ablations A (off-policy SFT), B (6 contiguous layers), C (over-constrained gate).
runs_and_variance: two training runs (Run A peak 27/36, Run B on-disk 25/36); "72.22% ± 2.78%" mean ± SD across the two runs; 8-12 tasks per domain
robustness_of_edits: evaluated directly in Q4_K/Q6_K quantized GGUF on llama-server; long-rollout control identity only "8/12 in Run A and 4/12 in Run B"
verification: IEEE-754 dead-zone theorem for GELU_tanh and per-layer gate leak statistics; programmatic oracles for training data
limitations_stated: N < 100 samples per domain limits out-of-family generalization; Layer 35 riscv gate leaks (val_neg_max = -1.66); some hard-negative tasks not overridden.
code_or_data: Hermetic_Airlock_v8_Reproducibility_Kit.zip in Zenodo record 24128862; base GGUF at https://huggingface.co/moneykoikoi/Omega-Spatial-v5-Apex
notes_for_survey: Uses 'weight-space programming' for orthogonal adapters and appended-neuron modules; does not cite Takehi et al. Values are trained, so it is closer to adapter fine-tuning than to WSP. No AI-authorship statement found.
